description: Level 4 retry - RCA generated but validation failed or confidence score too low. Re-run validation agent from stage3_validate queue.
precondition_summary: Alert has latest_effective_rca_id set. Active rca_results doc exists. Re-validate RCA against updated RAG DB.

alert.alert_text: ALERT: Disk Space Critical on prod-k8s-node-07. Severity: Critical. The root filesystem on host prod-k8s-node-07 has reached 95% utilization. Linux Ubuntu 22.04 machine running containerized workloads in us-west-2 AWS region. Container logs and temp files are primary consumers. Disk I/O is elevated. Application health checks are intermittently failing. Mount point affected: /var/lib/docker.

triaging_steps.action: Check disk usage breakdown by directory

tool_params.query: index=syslog host={host} "disk" earliest=-1h | stats count by directory

triaging_results.action: Check disk usage breakdown by directory

triaging_results.result: I/O wait at 85% over last 2 hours, spike started at 12:00 UTC
Kubelet health check returning 503 - storage pressure detected

rca_result.root_cause: Docker overlay2 filesystem consuming 68GB due to orphaned container layers not cleaned up after pod eviction events. Combined with container log rotation misconfiguration.
rca_result.impact: Kubelet under storage pressure causing pod scheduling failures. Intermittent application health check failures affecting service availability.
rca_result.recommendation: 1. Run docker system prune -f to remove dangling images and stopped containers. 2. Fix log rotation config in /etc/logrotate.d/containers. 3. Set up automated cleanup cron job.
